claim_summary: For the exact-spectrum circular Parseval Schur-isotropic family, every applicable one-pivot rank-two Schur certificate is at least (8*2^(1/4)/sqrt(3))*sqrt(m); two or more nonzero pivots cannot terminate in rank two because ambient rank is three. Together with the prior single rank-three cross-volume barrier, the sequence r=m defeats both current certificates while the positive half-line remains bounded by pi*sqrt(2). This is a proof-method obstruction, not a QFORM counterexample.
